rows.note: Use 地質學 for geology as an academic science; it is the all-purpose rendering for this sense.

example.english: I'm studying geology to understand how the Earth formed.
example.traditional: 我讀緊地質學，想了解下地球點樣形成。
example.jyutping: ngo5 duk6 gan2 dei6 zat1 hok6 soeng2 liu5 gaai2 haa5 dei6 kau4 dim2 joeng2 jing4 sing4

rows.note: Use 地質 when referring to the geological character or structure of a particular region, such as the Alps.

example.english: The geology of this area is quite complex, so we need to survey it before building.
example.traditional: 呢區地質比較複雜，起樓前要先做勘探。
example.jyutping: ni1 keoi1 dei6 zat1 bei2 gaau3 fuk1 zaap6 hei2 lau4 cin4 jiu3 sin1 zou6 ham1 taam3
